sentences.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
sentences.zh: 该法案的支持者说客将贿赂款汇入了一个竞选基金。

sentences.en: Beyle wishes lobbyists would stop speaking for her.
sentences.zh: 贝尔希望那些为她发声的说客能停止这样做。

sentences.en: The lobbyists formed a special interest group.
sentences.zh: 这些说客成立了一个特殊利益集团。
